title: PG&E Uses Generative AI to Cut Document Search Time at Diablo Canyon - Business Insider
summary: PG&E's Diablo Canyon Power Plant operations were extended through 2030 due to new legislation, prompting the company to streamline its administrative processes using AI. A collaboration led to the creation of Neutron, an AI tool to manage regulatory documents efficiently.
sentiment_reason: The extension of the power plant's operations and the implementation of AI to improve efficiency are positive developments for the nuclear sector and PG&E.
